Tired of eye strain from overly transparent UI designs when building AI apps? 🤖✨

Standard liquid glass interfaces look futuristic, but they turn information-dense agent workspaces into a blur of low readability, especially when dealing with rapid text streaming and multi-step tool execution.

Meet Solid Glass (https://github.com/deeplethe/solid-glass)—a specialized design system built on shadcn/ui that delivers tactile, high-clarity UI components tailored specifically for AI agents and complex agentic interfaces.

Instead of extreme transparency, Solid Glass uses solid outlines, fine borders, and depth-based shadows to create a calm, legible workspace where your data always stays in focus. 

Why developers love it:
⚡ Drop-in integration: Works seamlessly with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS 4 via a single stylesheet targeting existing data-slot attributes—no complete component rewrites required.
🛠️ Agent-first registry: Comes equipped with status glyphs, tool steps, diff views, reasoning blocks, and task notices.
🧊 Unified material styling: Three distinct thicknesses of glass with refined edge highlights, soft shadows, and robust light and dark mode support.
🎛️ Interactive customizer: Use the Create page to dynamically tune parameters like thickness, tint, radius, and rim to generate custom CSS variable configurations instantly.

Whether you are building multi-agent workspaces with live task streaming or developer tools with side-by-side diff views, Solid Glass saves you hundreds of hours of custom design system engineering.

Check out the repo and give your AI app the tactile UI it deserves:
https://github.com/deeplethe/solid-glass

What if your standard JavaScript loops and if-statements could run instantly as fully differentiable neural networks on your GPU—without any training data? 🤯

Meet `chenglou/handwired`, a mind-bending tool that translates regular JavaScript control flows into exact, untrained, yet fully differentiable neural networks running on WebGPU.

The Problem:
Bridging traditional imperative programming with neural network representations has always meant tedious data collection and training. Handwired changes the game by transforming standard JavaScript constructs like conditionals and loops directly into basic arithmetic primitives such as matrix multiplications and ReLUs. 

Key Features:
• Exact Arithmetic Compilation: Translates if-else statements, loops, and state changes into continuous mathematical equivalents using ReLU functions and weighted branch selection.
• Full Differentiability: Because the compiled programs rely solely on addition, multiplication, and ReLU primitives, the entire execution graph remains fully differentiable.
• WebGPU Acceleration: Packs the collected primitives into giant matrix multiplications executed via WebGPU for massive parallel speedups.
• Zero-Training Weights: Weights are written manually via the source logic rather than learned through gradient descent, ensuring immediate correctness.

Why You Need It:
Execute traditional single-threaded JavaScript code with GPU-level parallelism, unlocking extreme performance for data-heavy tasks like searching massive JSON documents. Plus, you can unlock creative architectural patterns like unfreezing hand-written program weights for fine-tuning, or hybridizing explicit business logic with generic neural networks (like nanoGPT) for end-to-end training.

Check it out on GitHub and let us know what you'll build with it:
https://github.com/chenglou/handwired

Tired of paying hefty monthly subscriptions for closed-source design SaaS tools just to create marketing assets or let users edit templates? Meet Doory—an ambitious, self-hosted, open-source Canva alternative built for your own infrastructure. 🚀

Doory solves the lack of privacy-focused, customizable design suites by offering a complete browser-based graphic editor. Whether you are building posters, social media posts, presentations, or resumes from scratch or templates, you can now host your own design powerhouse without depending on third-party cloud services. 

Here is what makes Doory a game-changer for developers and tech enthusiasts:

✨ Comprehensive In-Browser Editing & Animation: A full toolchain featuring layer management, advanced text effects, curved text, 27,500+ vector elements, and a robust motion engine supporting enter/exit animations, page transitions, and audio loops.
📄 Seamless Export Engine: Client-side and server-side pipelines generating print-ready PDFs with bleed and crop marks, alongside high-def video and animated web media formats (MP4, GIF).
👥 Real-Time Collaboration: Built-in multi-user co-editing, share links with role-based permissions, comment pinning, and a complete design version history.
🐳 Batter-Included Self-Hosting: Docker-ready architecture with automated management commands for seeding templates, syncing massive open-licensed font catalogues, stock photo providers, and background removal ML models.

Use cases range from deploying a private, internal company brand asset generator behind corporate firewalls to embedding a white-labeled graphic editor directly into your existing SaaS platform. Bypass SaaS lock-in and study complex web canvas manipulation, real-time sync implementation, and multi-format export pipelines today.

Check out the repository and deploy it with Docker:
https://github.com/shaongitbd/doory

Tired of paying crazy monthly SaaS fees just because your newsletter subscriber list grew? 💸

Mainstream newsletter platforms charge you a fortune based on total subscriber counts—even for dead emails and inactive readers. 

Meet MailCheap: the open-source, self-hosted newsletter platform that shifts email economics. 🚀 Instead of tiering prices, it connects directly to Amazon SES so you only pay fractions of a cent for the exact number of emails you actually send. 

Built specifically for indie hackers, full-stack devs, and technical founders, it gives you complete data ownership and programmatic control.

✨ Key Features You’ll Love:
🤖 AI Agent Integration (MCP Server): Let ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Claude Code write, review, and send newsletters securely using OAuth or API keys.
🛡️ Deliverability Guardrails: Includes automatic smart warm-ups (sending initial 5% slices), automated list cleanup, spam-trap elimination, and hard bounce circuit breakers.
🔄 Seamless Migrations: Import existing lists, statuses, and signup dates via CSV from Beehiiv, Substack, Mailchimp, Kit, and Ghost without losing history.
⚡ Developer-First Stack: Built on Node.js 22+, MongoDB, and Upstash QStash, making it easily deployable on Vercel or custom infrastructure.

Stop letting legacy platforms tax your growth. Take back your email infrastructure today!

Check out the repo and drop a star:
https://github.com/marclou/mailcheap

Stop chasing keyword tools that only show you what mattered last month. 🚀

If you are building in AI, you already know that the biggest SEO arbitrage opportunities and product integrations happen days before traditional tools even register a new term. 

Introducing `new-term-radar` (Ranked #5 on GitHub): An automated trend-spotting radar that catches emerging AI models, repos, and products on X and GitHub before keyword tools ever see them. 📈

The Problem:
Mainstream SEO tools suffer from a massive delay problem. By the time a new AI model, open-source repo, or software tool shows up in search volume data, the early-mover advantage is completely gone.

What It Does:
This project monitors the earliest digital footprints of emerging AI terminology—such as lab announcements on X, Hugging Face trending models, GitHub velocity, and sitemap shifts—giving you a massive head start.

Key Features Built for Devs & Growth Engineers:
- Multi-Signal Ingestion: Monitors X accounts, GitHub velocity, Hugging Face trending items, directory sitemaps, new domains, Reddit requests, and TrustMRR revenue.
- Automated Keyword Mapping: Pairs newly spotted names with generic search phrases, screens for relevance, and estimates search volume via Google Trends data.
- Page-One Difficulty Checker: Evaluates Google search result pages to determine if a new term is open for optimization or crowded by established domains.
- Flexible Deployment: Supports command-line usage, agent skills, an MCP server, and automated reporting intervals.

Use Cases:
- Automate the creation of directory pages and niche documentation for newly released open-source AI repositories the day they break out.
- Integrate the radar into your developer newsletter pipeline to automatically surface trending AI tools before they appear in major aggregators.

Programmatically capture early-stage product and model launches straight from raw GitHub and social signals, and spin up landing pages or integrations before your competitors even notice the demand. 💡

Check out the repository and start tracking tomorrow's trends today:
https://github.com/zhuyansen/new-term-radar
